components.name: Primary Session Action
components.description: Main permission or response action for a waiting session.
components.css: .ds-primary { border: 1px solid #435b35; border-radius: 7px; background: #435b35; color: #fff; padding: 8px 11px; font: 600 12px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #324b27; border-color: #324b27; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8a5b18; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Alternative session action with a quiet outline.
components.css: .ds-secondary { border: 1px solid #b9b09b; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #302b21; padding: 8px 11px; font: 600 12px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover { background: #eae2d0; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8a5b18; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Waiting Session Row
components.description: Flat session row that highlights a request needing attention.
components.css: .ds-waiting { border-top: 1px solid #dfd8c8; background: #f7f0df; color: #302b21; padding: 15px 20px; font: 400 12px/1.5 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-waiting strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-waiting p { color: #716957; } .ds-waiting span { color: #8a5b18; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Quota Row
components.css: .ds-quota { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 110px 1fr 38px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 12px; color: #716957; font: 400 12px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-quota > div { height: 4px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 3px; background: #e3ddce; } .ds-quota i { display: block; width: 72%; height: 100%; background: #73845b; } .ds-quota strong { color: #302b21; text-align: right; }

components.name: Pet Waiting Badge
components.description: Amber count attached to the front-facing companion when sessions wait.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-grid; min-width: 23px; height: 23px; place-items: center; border: 2px solid #faf7ed; border-radius: 50%; background: #8a5b18; color: #fff; font: 700 12px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Capy places a warm, front-facing animated capivara over a quiet synthetic Windows desktop. The approved front-facing SVG in `prototypes/front-pet.svg` is the standard artwork and is loaded unchanged by the TypeScript interface. A compact oat-colored summary carries the useful session detail; the wider panel gives the demonstration controls room without changing the product's calm, companion-like world.

The Rust and Tauri shell provides three native surfaces: a transparent 200×180 pet window, a 380×620 summary, and a 760×680 panel. The summary favors compact, readable rows, soft dividers, and clear labels. All displayed sessions, replies, scenarios, and quota values are explicitly synthetic demo data; the interface does not imply live agent integrations.
keyCharacteristics: The approved front-facing capivara is the persistent companion and remains movable.
The native summary and full panel share warm oat surfaces, dark brown text, olive actions, and amber attention states.
Session rows stay flat and use soft dividers; demo controls live in the full panel.
Segoe UI and compact spacing keep session details legible.

rules.name: The Attention Amber Rule
rules.body: Use amber for requests and attention states; keep routine actions olive.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use Segoe UI throughout the interface; reserve Consolas for command-like demo content.

dos: Do preserve the approved front-facing SVG as the standard companion artwork.
Do keep olive for routine actions and amber for attention states.
Do keep project, agent, and origin legible together in each session row.
Do label sessions, replies, and quota values as synthetic demonstration data.
Do keep the summary compact and expose the full panel for scenario controls.
donts: Don't nest cards inside the session list; use rows and soft dividers.
Don't imply live agent discovery, responses, or quota access from the demonstration.
Don't replace or modify the approved front-facing mascot artwork.
